market.title: Big Brother Season 28 Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever houseguest is named the winner on the live finale, currently set for a 90-minute special on Thursday, Oct 1, 2026 - the last one standing takes home the $750,000 grand prize.

Kalshi's own wording: "If [houseguest] are officially declared the winner of Big Brother Season 28, then the market resolves to Yes." Kalshi and Polymarket both list every houseguest as a separate Yes/No contract rather than one multi-choice market, so each name's price is its own independent read on the field, not a slice of a fixed 100%.
Only the 5 real contenders by current price are tracked here out of 17 total houseguests - the rest are sitting at a nominal 1-2% on both platforms with no realistic path to the money.

text: Big Brother 28 premiered on CBS on July 9, 2026 with 14 first-time contestants including an MMA fighter and a RuPaul's Drag Race alum.

Subtitled 'Time Trip,' the 28th edition of the programme also features three surprise crossover/return guests, Survivor winner Dee Valladares, Survivor alum Rick Devens, and former Big Brother contestant Angela Murray.
Valladares has been an early favorite on the show, shooting to the top spot on Kalshi in the early weeks, leading second-place favorite Rick Devens.
The Time Trip format has scrambled alliances more than a usual season, with a time-travel theme and time-based rooms that houseguests have to navigate.
Prediction markets have become a genuine spoiler problem for reality TV this season - Kalshi's contestant pricing has, in past seasons, tipped off eventual winners and eliminations.
